# IAS NOVA

> > IAS NOVA is an AI-powered adaptive learning platform delivering smart UPSC preparation through trend-based modules, interactive quizzes, and comprehensive revision guides across all major subjects.

IAS NOVA provides structured preparation for the UPSC Civil Services Examination with subject-specific revision strategies, quick capsules, and interactive learning tools. The platform combines NCERT-based content with 10-year exam trend analysis to help aspirants focus on high-yield topics.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Prelims & Mains Exam
- NCERT Revision Strategy
- Smart Learning Modules
- Current Affairs & Geopolitics
- Indian Geography
- Indian History & Philosophy
- Polity & Constitution
- Economics
- International Relations
- Energy Security
- Maritime Chokepoints
- Ancient Indian Civilization
- Exam Strategy
- Quick Revision Capsules
- Interactive Learning Games

- [HOME - IAS NOVA](https://iasnova.com): IAS NOVA homepage: AI-powered smart prep platform for UPSC with modules, quizzes, and interactive learning tools

- [About us](https://iasnova.com/about-us): IASNOVA mission and vision: AI-powered adaptive learning platform for smart UPSC preparation

## UPSC Prelims: Topic Analysis & Strategy

- [TOPICS THAT HAVE BEEN FREQUENTLY ASKED IN UPSC PRELIMS EXAM](https://iasnova.com/topics-frequently-asked-in-upsc-prelims-exam): Analysis of frequently tested UPSC Prelims topics with priority areas and question patterns
- [POLITY- MOST IMPORTANT TOPICS](https://iasnova.com/polity-most-important-topics): High-yield polity topics based on M. Laxmikanth's guide for UPSC Prelims exam
- [Revision Strategy for GEOGRAPHY- NCERT & Other Important Topics](https://iasnova.com/geography-upsc-important-topics-ncert-revision): Geography revision guide with NCERT topics, 10-year trends for UPSC Prelims and Mains
- [Revision Strategy for ECONOMICS- NCERT & Other Important Topics](https://iasnova.com/revision-strategy-for-economics-ncert-other-important-topics): Economics revision guide covering NCERT chapters, macroeconomics, and WTO for UPSC

## History & Ancient Indian Philosophy

- [HISTORY REVISION STRATEGY](https://iasnova.com/history-revision-strategy): History revision strategy with important NCERT chapters from ancient to modern India
- [INDUS VALLEY CIVILIZATION (Harappan Civilisation): Quick Revision Module for UPSC History](https://iasnova.com/indus-valley-civilization-harappan-civilisation-quick-revision-upsc-ancient-history): Quick revision module on Indus Valley Civilization covering timeline, sites, and archaeology
- [Darshana Traditions: 14 Schools of Ancient Indian Philosophy (Āstika & Nāstika) — Complete Guide](https://iasnova.com/darshana-traditions-14-schools-of-ancient-indian-philosophy-astika-nastika-ancient-history): Complete guide to 14 Darshana schools of Indian philosophy: Astika and Nastika traditions
- [PHILOSOPHY IN ANCIENT INDIA-NCERT REVISION CAPSULE](https://iasnova.com/philosophy-in-ancient-india-ncert-revison-capsule): Revision capsule on six schools of ancient Indian philosophy: Samkhya, Yoga, Nyaya, Vaisheshika, Mimansa, Vedanta
- [BUDDHISM- Revision Capsule for UPSC Prelims Exam](https://iasnova.com/buddhism-revision-capsule): Buddhism revision capsule covering Buddha's life, Four Noble Truths, and Buddhist sects for UPSC
- [Jainism – Revision Capsule](https://iasnova.com/jainism-revision-capsule): Jainism revision guide covering 24 Tirthankaras, five vows, and Triratna philosophy

## Geography & Geopolitics

- [Indian Monsoon: Mechanism, ITCZ, IOD & ENSO (Complete UPSC Guide)](https://iasnova.com/indian-monsoon-upsc): Complete guide to Indian monsoon mechanism, ITCZ, IOD, ENSO for UPSC GS Paper 1
- [Strait of Hormuz Crisis Explained: UPSC Geography, IR & India's Energy Security](https://iasnova.com/strait-of-hormuz-crisis-explained-upsc-geography-ir-indias-energy-security): Strait of Hormuz crisis analysis for UPSC covering energy security and West Asia geopolitics
